mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy environment that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS decline periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 9.0% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger risk-off sentiment, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in UNRATE > 9.0% periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) over the prior 2 months indicates weakening consumer demand, triggering negative equity market returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint decline of RSAFS and HOUST does not produce significantly negative 20-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03) or fails in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (GDP growth > 3% annualized, UNRATE < 5%), housing starts (HOUST) below 550 thousand units signals impending demand slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns in late-cycle expansion with HOUST < 550 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 90.0 in a 3-month window, it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns in INDPRO < 90.0 periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4.0% in a 3-month window, it signals monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns in FEDFUNDS > 4.0% periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 8.5%), a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 130,000 thousand units signals worsening labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns in high-unemployment with PAYEMS decline are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL above 225 and decline in FEDFUNDS below 0.1% signals inflationary pressure with accommodative policy, triggering positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint condition of CPIAUCSL > 225 and FEDFUNDS < 0.1% does not produce significantly positive 60-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03) or fails in >60% of triggered instances.
